foot_note: Summaries and facts verified against repo READMEs and GitHub APIs (2026-10-04)
insight: **Agent infrastructure has solidified into clear layers**: The trending charts this cycle are dominated by the same recurring stack—sandboxing (NVIDIA/OpenShell), memory (hindsight / claude-mem), team orchestration (paperclip / openrig / ECC), interaction surfaces (t3code), and web access (Agent-Reach). The battleground has shifted from raw model capability to the underlying substrate powering the agent.

**The memory layer is the most contested frontier**: hindsight sets a high benchmark with third-party reproducible LongMemEval scores, while claude-mem pursues a plug-and-play approach with single-command integration into any test harness—together adding +15k stars this week. Conveniently, my local Hermes setup uses hindsight as its backing store (`bank: hermes`), making it easy to run a quick side-by-side benchmark.

**Safety and cost governance have become the primary selling points**: OpenShell bakes security policies directly into the kernel with formal verification; Paperclip focuses on budget limits, alerts, and automated pauses upon hitting thresholds; OpenMontage runs ffprobe, frame sampling, and audio level sanity checks before every delivery while keeping auditable provider scoring logs. Now that agents can run end-to-end, only those proving they 'won't cause havoc and won't burn through cash' get a seat at the production table.

**Tech giants and solo developers compete on the same stage**: NVIDIA (OpenShell) and Alibaba (open-code-review) entered the arena armed with battle-tested internal production data, going head-to-head with breakout indie hits like ponytail, impeccable, and Agent-Reach (+1.9k to +3.3k stars in a single week). This makes it clear that the real barrier to entry in agent tooling isn't massive capital investment—it's having a crystal-clear understanding of the problem constraints.

rows.intro: An agent skill that makes AI coding agents think like the "laziest senior engineer on your team": write as little code as possible, treat YAGNI as the default—the best code is the code you never wrote.
facts: Badges indicate compatibility with 20+ coding agents; official site: ponytail.dev; MIT licensed.
Published on npm as `@dietrichgebert/ponytail`; GitHub topics include `yagni`, `claude-code-plugin`, `cursor-rules`, and `agent-skills`.
Created in 2026-06; verified via GitHub API at over 137k+ stars ~3 months post-launch (sampled 2026-09).
Persona: "He says nothing, writes one line, and it works"—cuts fluff and over-engineering (direct quote from README).

rows.intro: A frontend design standards skill for AI coding agents to stop models from outputting obviously "AI-generated" UIs—the ubiquitous generic SaaS template vibe, Inter font, purple-blue gradients, and cards inside cards.
facts: Features 1 skill + 24 commands (`polish`, `audit`, `critique`, `distill`, `animate`, `bolder`, `quieter`, etc.) + 61 deterministic validation rules; the CLI and browser extension run rules without LLM calls or API keys (per README).

Installation: run `npx impeccable install` in the project root, then execute `/impeccable init` within your AI tool to generate `PRODUCT.md`, locking in long-term product facts (audience, intent, constraints, tone) to prevent confusion with visual styling.

Originated from Anthropic's `frontend-design` skill as actionable constraints against "all models trained into the same template"; includes a VS Code extension (requires 1.109.3+ and Copilot Chat) and multi-host support for Grok, Gemini CLI, and more.
Apache-2.0 licensed by pbakaus; official site: impeccable.style; verified via GitHub API at 76k+ stars (sampled 2026-10).

rows.intro: A CLI + Skill giving AI agents one-click "internet access": enables Claude Code, Cursor, OpenClaw, and others to read and search Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and Xiaohongshu with zero API costs.
facts: A single CLI plus `SKILL.md`—no memorizing commands, agents invoke tools autonomously; uses "primary + fallback" multi-backend routing per platform with auto-failover (e.g., switched to `bili-cli` after Bilibili anti-scraping blocked `yt-dlp` in 2026-06 with zero user intervention).

Fully open source with free APIs; the only potential cost is an overseas proxy (~$1/mo) while running locally is free; covers web-wide semantic search (via MCP), Xiaohongshu, and Xiaoyuzhou podcast transcription (via Whisper).

Login-required platforms require explicit user authorization: Twitter only accepts manual Cookie-Editor exports (no automated logins or cookie injection); OpenClaw users must grant `exec` permissions beforehand, or agents cannot run commands like `pip install`.
MIT licensed, requires Python 3.10+, with README available in EN/ZH/JA/KO; badges show it previously hit #1 on GitHub Trending Daily; verified via GitHub API at 90k+ stars (sampled 2026-10).

rows.intro: A cross-session agent memory plugin: logs everything an agent does in a session, compresses it with AI, and reinjects relevant context into future sessions—works across Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode, and more.
facts: One-command install: `npx claude-mem install` (or `/plugin install claude-mem` in Claude Code, or `install.cmem.ai` script in OpenClaw); specify the host via `--ide opencode / grok-bot / antigravity / omp`.

Three memory provider options: official hosted `claude-mem observer` (browser email login, no card required, 14-day free trial without consuming your plan quota), bring-your-own OpenRouter/Gemini key, or direct Anthropic plan; also supports `--provider host` for local observation with optional login bypass in CI.

Note that `claude-mem` on npm is solely an SDK/library; installing the plugin requires `npx` or `/plugin`, otherwise plugin hooks and worker services will not be registered (stated explicitly in README).

Tech stack includes ChromaDB vector retrieval and `claude-agent-sdk` (from topics); Apache-2.0 licensed, created 2025-08, official site: claude-mem.ai; verified via GitHub API at 96k+ stars (sampled 2026-10).

rows.intro: An open-source CapCut alternative: a free video editor for web, desktop, and mobile.
facts: Currently undergoing a ground-up rewrite in Rust: targeting a single codebase for desktop, mobile, and web, with planned Editor APIs, first-class plugin architecture, MCP server for AI agents, headless batch rendering, and an in-editor scripting tab.

The currently available release is the classic edition at `opencut-app/opencut-classic`, which still powers opencut.app; the rewritten version is deployed at new.opencut.app until proven stable for takeover.
Developed with `proto` + `moon` toolchains (Node/Rust versions pinned via `.prototools`); provides setup guides for Linux, macOS, WSL, and Windows.
MIT licensed, created 2025-06, official site: opencut.app; verified via GitHub API at 92k+ stars (sampled 2026-10).

rows.intro: An "agent harness console": remotely control existing coding agent sessions running on your local machine (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, Antigravity) across mobile apps, web, and desktop.
facts: Available across three clients: official iOS/Android apps, web client at app.t3.codes, and an Electron desktop app—all interact with locally authenticated agents without transporting credentials.

Prerequisite is having at least one provider installed and authenticated locally: `codex login`, `claude auth login`, `agent login` (Cursor), `grok login`, or `opencode auth login`; Antigravity logs in via Google in settings without CLI.

Creator pingdotgg (Theo) explicitly states nothing is sold and there are no subscription fees: positioned as "performant, remote-capable, genuinely open source"—if the direction doesn't suit you, fork it into your preferred editor.
Install: `curl -fsSL https://t3.codes/install.sh | sh` (use `install.ps1` on Windows); MIT licensed, created 2026-02, official site: t3.codes; verified via GitHub API at 25k+ stars (sampled 2026-10).

rows.intro: Billed as the first open-source "agentic video production system": turns coding assistants into a full video production pipeline, delegating topic research, image generation, scriptwriting, voiceover, soundtrack selection, subtitle burning, and final rendering to agents.
facts: Features 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, and 700+ agent skills and production knowledge files; official 60-second demo short *THE LAST BANANA* cost $1.33 total using 6 Kling v3 shots (via fal.ai), Google Chirp3-HD narration, and Remotion composition.

The only hard dependency is FFmpeg; offers both `make` and manual installation flows (`Python venv` + `pip install -r requirements.txt` + `npm install` inside `remotion-composer` + `piper-tts`), with dedicated guides for macOS, Linux, and Windows.

Runs multi-point self-checks before delivery: `ffprobe` validation, frame sampling, audio level analysis, deliverable commitment checks, and subtitle inspection; scores provider choices across 7 dimensions with audit logs, requiring human sign-off on creative decisions.

Includes Backlot, a local dashboard displaying real-time pipeline progress and per-step costs; AGPL-3.0 licensed, created 2026-03, official site: openmontage.video; verified via GitHub API at 63k+ stars (sampled 2026-10).

rows.intro: A next-generation E2E testing framework for web and mobile: describe objectives in natural language, let AI agents drive the app to that state, and verify results in the same test using standard locators and assertions.
facts: Mixes natural language actions and assertions within the same test case: e.g., `await agent.act('upgrade workspace to Pro tier')` followed by `agent.assert(...)` or `expect(screen.getByRole('status')).toContainText('Pro')`.

Tests with agent steps verified by subsequent assertions record actions for zero-LLM replay on subsequent runs (re-invoking AI only when UI changes); tests without agent steps incur zero model consumption.

Bring your own model: personal subscriptions, API keys, or local models; modular npm packages include `e2e` (SDK/CLI), `@e2e-dev/web` (Chromium/Firefox/WebKit via Playwright), `@e2e-dev/mobile` (iOS/Android emulators), and `@e2e-dev/github` (posts results as PR comments).

Install with `npx e2e init` (interactive setup for engine, web/mobile targets, model provider); disable telemetry via `npx e2e telemetry disable`; Apache-2.0 licensed, created 2026-07, official site: tester.army/e2e; verified via GitHub API at 3,000+ stars (sampled 2026-10).

rows.intro: 完全本地运行的开源 ElevenLabs 替代品：声音克隆、音色设计、视频配音、听写转写与有声书制作一条龙，本地工作流不要账号、不要 API Key、不要订阅与用量计费。
facts: 默认引擎是 k2-fsa/OmniVoice，也可换其他引擎，官方提供 features & engine catalog；覆盖 646 种语言的克隆、设计与转写
三种用法：Electron 桌面应用（克隆 / 设计音色、带时间轴的视频配音、悬浮听写控件、批量任务）、本地 API 与 MCP 供 agent 调用、可选远程 worker 分担算力
硬件按引擎分档：NVIDIA GPU（Windows / Linux）走 CUDA 加速，Apple 侧有 MLX 支持（GitHub topics 实抓），性能对照表在 docs/performance.md
提供简体中文与日文 README，AGPL-3.0，2026-04 创建，官网 voicestudio.sh；GitHub API 实测 5.3 万+ star（2026-10 实抓）

rows.intro: 给 AI Agent 用的长期记忆系统：不只把对话历史记下来，而是让 agent 从经验里「学会」——官方称在 LongMemEval 长期记忆基准上取得当前最优成绩。
facts: 核心是三个操作 retain / recall / reflect，外加 observations、mental models & knowledge pages、banks 等概念；官方定位是「让 agent 学习，而不只是记住」
LongMemEval 成绩由第三方（Virginia Tech Sanghani Center、The Washington Post）独立复现，其他厂商分数为自报；实时榜单在 benchmarks.hindsight.vectorize.io，论文 arXiv:2512.12818
接入成本很低：LLM wrapper 两行代码，pip install hindsight-api / hindsight-client（Python）或 npm @vectorize-io/hindsight-client，另有 MCP server 与一批集成；还有 Hindsight Cloud 托管版
MIT 协议，2025-10 创建，官网 hindsight.vectorize.io；GitHub API 实测 4.5 万+ star（2026-10 实抓）

rows.intro: 开源的多 Agent「团队管理」应用：把一件事拆成企业目标，给不同 agent 分配岗位、预算与权限，在一个类似任务管理器的面板里盯进度和成本——官方原话「如果 OpenClaw 是员工，Paperclip 就是公司」。
facts: Node.js 服务 + React UI：agent 有岗位、汇报线、权限和预算，执行走 DB 支撑的 heartbeat 唤醒队列（合并唤醒、预算检查、工作区解析、密钥注入、技能加载、适配器调用）
适配器可混搭 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor（含 Cloud）、Gemini CLI、Pi、Hermes / Hermes Gateway、Grok Build、Kimi Code、OpenClaw 和 HTTP/webhook 机器人，也支持自定义进程与外部适配器包——「只要能被心跳唤醒，就算入职」
成本治理是重点：公司 / agent / 项目三级预算、花费追踪、阈值告警、到线自动暂停，专治 agent 死循环烧 token；任务、评论与文档留在 Paperclip 内，支持的适配器可恢复历史会话
MIT 协议，2026-03 创建，官网 paperclip.ing（另有 Cloud 等候名单）；GitHub API 实测 9.7 万+ star（2026-10 实抓）

rows.intro: 英伟达开源的自主 AI Agent 运行沙箱：给 agent 读文件、装包、调 API、用凭据的能力，同时用策略把它们关在笼子里，不让它们碰你的数据、密钥和网络。
facts: 双保险治理：一是内核级强制——每个 agent 跑在隔离沙箱，文件访问、系统调用和每个网络连接都过策略检查，且 agent 永远看不到真实凭据，只在发往白名单端点时注入；二是形式化验证——策略变更前先算出它新放开了什么（如「能带凭据访问新主机」），这类改动挂起等人工审
组成上是 CLI + 本地 gateway + sandbox 三件套，一条命令装：curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/main/install.sh | sh，然后 openshell sandbox create --name demo
默认沙箱镜像是最精简 Ubuntu、不带任何 agent；官方教程用 OpenCode + OpenRouter 免费模型跑第一个 agent，演示它需要新权限时你怎么逐次批准
Apache-2.0，PyPI 包名 openshell，文档 docs.nvidia.com/openshell，2026-02 创建；GitHub API 实测 1.48 万+ star（2026-10 实抓）

rows.intro: 从零到能交付的 AI 工程自学课程仓库：523 节课、20 个阶段、约 342 小时，主张「不只是学 AI，而是亲手把它造出来」，每节课都要交付一个可复用产物（prompt / skill / agent / MCP server）。
facts: 523 节课 / 20 个阶段 / 约 342 小时，语言覆盖 Python、TypeScript、Rust、Julia；每个 lesson 都要交出可复用产物，MIT 协议、全部免费
不止「大而全」：提供按目标走的路线，例如 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的 17 节专线、Agent Skills 工程路线，以及 MCPA（MCP Associate）认证备考轨道
可直接在你已有的 host 里开学：对 agent 说 use start-learning 开课、learn-mcp 走 MCP 线、learn-agent-skills 走技能线、check-understanding 做阶段测验，会生成 MCP-LEARNING.md 之类的进度文件
配套官网 aiengineeringfromscratch.com，README 有 12 种语言版本；2026-03 创建，GitHub API 实测 6.4 万+ star（2026-10 实抓）

rows.intro: 给多 agent 团队用的「机架」：用 YAML 定义你的 agent 团队，一条命令把 Claude Code 和 Codex 装进同一个 rig，当成一个系统来管。
facts: 定位一句话：harness 包住模型，rig 包住你的 harness。它把散落的终端会话变成有岗位、有共享上下文、各自认领工作的常驻团队，你只需跟 lead agent 谈目标，它再协调各团队专家
环境要求 Node.js 22 或 24 + tmux，仅 macOS / Linux（原生 Windows 不支持、WSL2 未测）；安装 npm install -g @openrig/cli，建议先 rig setup --dry-run 预览会改哪些文件
复用你已有的账号：Claude Code、Codex 任选或都要，不需要再买订阅；launch 前会问一次是否允许 agent 免重复确认执行 rig 命令（可撤销），并会写入 provider hooks 与 workspace trust 设置
作者 mvschwarz 用它跑自己的「AI 文明」实验，配套 TUI 可视化（团队图 → agent 座位表 → 单座详情，含 runtime / 模型 / 上下文 / 状态）；Apache-2.0，2026-04 创建，官网 openrig.dev；GitHub API 实测约 5,000 star（2026-10 实抓）

rows.intro: 给 AI Agent 一键装上「互联网能力」的 CLI + Skill：让 Claude Code、Cursor、OpenClaw 等能读能搜 Twitter/X、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、B 站、小红书，零 API 费用（今日榜 #3，见上）。
facts: 一个 CLI 加一份 SKILL.md，不用背命令、Agent 自己知道调什么；每个平台走「首选 + 备选」多后端路由，接入方式失效自动切换（README 举例：2026-06 B 站风控封死 yt-dlp 后切 bili-cli，用户零操作）
全部工具开源、API 免费，唯一可能花钱的是海外服务器代理（约 $1/月），本地电脑不用付费；已覆盖全网语义搜索（MCP 接入）、小红书、小宇宙播客转录（Whisper）等
需登录的平台必须由用户显式授权：Twitter 只接受 Cookie-Editor 手工导出，不代登录、不注入 Cookie；OpenClaw 用户要先开 exec 权限，否则 Agent 跑不了 pip install 这类命令
MIT 协议，Python 3.10+，README 有中/英/日/韩版；官方 badge 显示曾登 GitHub Trending 日榜第一，GitHub API 实测 9.0 万+ star（2026-10 实抓）

rows.intro: 给 AI 编码代理用的前端设计规范技能：让模型别再输出一眼就看出「AI 生成」的界面——同一个 SaaS 模板味、Inter 字体、紫蓝渐变、卡片套卡片（今日榜 #2，见上）。
facts: 一个 skill + 24 条命令（polish / audit / critique / distill / animate / bolder / quieter 等）+ 61 条确定性检测规则；CLI 与浏览器插件跑规则时不调 LLM、不要 API Key（README 实述）
安装：项目根目录 npx impeccable install，再在 AI 工具里跑 /impeccable init 生成 PRODUCT.md，把受众、目的、约束、语气等长期产品事实固定下来，避免和视觉方向混淆
起点是 Anthropic 的 frontend-design skill，专门针对「所有模型都训练出同一套模板」的可执行约束；另有 VS Code 扩展（需 1.109.3+ 与 Copilot Chat）和 Grok / Gemini CLI 等多宿主接入
Apache-2.0，作者 pbakaus，官网 impeccable.style；GitHub API 实测 7.6 万+ star（2026-10 实抓）

rows.intro: An 'Architecture as Code' skill for coding agents: converts codebases or system descriptions directly into interactive architecture, flow, or sequence diagrams within chat—outputting self-contained, animated HTML+SVG with clean exports and pre-merge architecture reviews.
facts: Supports 5 diagram types, 4 presets, dark/light themes, custom branding, and subtle animations; outputs self-contained HTML and exports to PNG, SVG, WebM, and 1200×630 social share cards (per README).
Supports review workflows: compares two verified snapshots across Before / Delta / After, precisely listing additions, removals, modifications, migrations, and reroutes.
Agents emit a typed JSON IR that Archify deterministically compiles into HTML/SVG with traceable, non-hallucinated topologies; supports Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode.
MIT license, created in 2026-04; 60k+ stars via GitHub API (verified 2026-09), #1 on this month's trending chart.

facts: Badges indicate compatibility with 20+ coding agents; official site ponytail.dev; MIT licensed.

Persona: 'He says nothing, writes one line, and it works'—eliminating fluff and over-engineering (direct translation from README).

rows.intro: An in-browser 'spy satellite simulator' powered entirely by real data: aggregates flight transponders, ship beacons, orbiting satellites, seismic stations, and public webcams onto a photorealistic 3D globe; runs locally with auditable, extensible code.
facts: Created by bilawalsidhu from the hit YouTube series *God's Eye View* (formerly *WorldView*, 5M+ YouTube views, 25M+ social views); hit #1 on GitHub Trending daily and weekly charts in 2026-08, and #8 Product Hunt Product of the Day (per README).

Two installation paths: one-click via Pinokio desktop (Windows / macOS / Linux, requires Pinokio 8.2+), or run locally via terminal / coding agents; no account or API keys required for flights, military & satellites, earthquakes, public webcams, radio, and rocket launch layers.

Photorealistic 3D terrain requires your own Cesium ion token (personal non-commercial) or Google Maps key added in the in-app POWER UP panel; traffic data simulates along real roads; webcam poses and rocket trajectories are rough estimates.

Features: cockpit view, 250km target roster, click-to-track any entity, voice whiteboard, GLSL sensor shaders (CRT/NVG/FLIR/Noir), military HUD, scene director, and shareable tracking links; each layer is an isolated module with swappable data feeds; created 2026-06, 31k+ stars via GitHub API (verified 2026-09).

rows.intro: A harness performance optimization system for coding agents: combines skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first workflows to make Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, and others run faster and more reliably.
facts: Homepage at ecc.tools; README describes it as an agent harness operating system spanning 5 core dimensions: skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first.
Explicitly supports major coding agents including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Cursor (official description).
Documentation available in multiple languages including English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Russian; MIT license, created in 2026-01.
Over 257k stars via GitHub API (verified 2026-09), consistently topping monthly trending charts.

rows.intro: A skill pack for AI coding assistants: forces them to put answers upfront—action-first, numbered steps, zero conversational filler, making outputs friendlier for ADHD users (and everyone else).
facts: Installed as a skill/plugin into CLI coding assistants like Claude Code (INSTALL.md guide in README); official docs note no ADHD diagnosis needed to benefit.
Core rules are Action first + numbered steps: the README demonstrates before-and-after examples of never burying conclusions in walls of analysis.
README provided in 7 languages (EN / ZH / JA / PT / VI / KO / TH); MIT license, created in 2026-05.
Over 44k stars via GitHub API (verified 2026-09), maintaining a steady presence atop weekly and monthly charts.

rows.intro: A long-term memory system for AI agents: goes beyond storing chat history to let agents actively 'learn' from experience—officially claims SOTA results on the LongMemEval long-term memory benchmark (#2 on this week's chart, see above).
facts: Centered on three core operations: retain, recall, and reflect, alongside concepts like observations, mental models & knowledge pages, and banks; positioned as 'enabling agents to learn, not just remember'.

LongMemEval scores were independently reproduced by third parties (Virginia Tech Sanghani Center, The Washington Post), whereas other vendors' scores are self-reported; live leaderboard at benchmarks.hindsight.vectorize.io, paper at arXiv:2512.12818.

Low integration overhead: two lines of code for the LLM wrapper, `pip install hindsight-api` / `hindsight-client` (Python) or npm `@vectorize-io/hindsight-client`, plus an MCP server and integrations; also offers hosted Hindsight Cloud.
MIT license, created 2025-10, official site hindsight.vectorize.io; 45k+ stars via GitHub API (verified 2026-10).

rows.intro: Alibaba open-sourced its internal AI code review assistant used for two years: a hybrid architecture combining a deterministic pipeline with a tool-augmented LLM Agent that reviews Git diffs down to exact lines of code; internally served tens of thousands of developers and identified millions of defects.
facts: Single-command npm install: `npm install -g @alibaba-group/open-code-review`, configure models via `ocr config provider` / `ocr config model`, and run reviews with `ocr review`; supports `ocr review --from main --to feature-branch` or `--commit <sha>`.

Beyond diff inspection: `ocr scan` audits entire repos or specific directories with `--resume` checkpointing; `ocr review --format json --output result.json` emits structured outputs for CI, alongside `ocr delegate` for rule delegation.

Addresses 3 major pitfalls of code review agents (location drift, surface-level diffing, insufficient context): reads full files, searches codebases, and cross-references related changes; includes built-in multilingual rule sets (NPE, thread safety, XSS, SQL injection), compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic.
Apache-2.0 license, created 2026-05, website open-codereview.ai, npm package `@alibaba-group/open-code-review`; 44k+ stars via GitHub API (verified 2026-10).

rows.intro: An open-source multi-agent 'team management' app: decomposes tasks into company objectives, assigns roles, budgets, and permissions across agents, and monitors progress and spend in a task-manager-style dashboard—in their words: 'If OpenClaw is the employee, Paperclip is the company' (#3 on this week's chart, see above).
facts: Node.js backend + React UI: agents have roles, reporting lines, permissions, and budgets; execution relies on a DB-backed heartbeat wake-up queue (coalesced wakeups, budget checks, workspace resolution, secret injection, skill loading, adapter invocation).

Adapters can mix and match Claude Code, Codex, Cursor (incl. Cloud), Gemini CLI, Pi, Hermes / Hermes Gateway, Grok Build, Kimi Code, OpenClaw, and HTTP/webhook bots, plus custom processes and external adapter packages—'if it can wake on a heartbeat, it's hired'.

Cost governance at the core: 3-tier budgets across company / agent / project, spend tracking, threshold alerts, and auto-pause at limits to prevent runaway token burning; tasks, comments, and docs stay inside Paperclip, with session resumption for supported adapters.
MIT license, created 2026-03, official site paperclip.ing (with Cloud waitlist); 97k+ stars via GitHub API (verified 2026-10).
